# Kudzaishe Zharare

> Full-stack software engineer building identity and payment systems

MIT B.S. in Computer Science and Mathematics, 2019. Work spans user-facing applications, cloud architecture, AI agent workflows, and engineering delivery.

## Selected evidence

- Cleva: reduced identity verification waits from 2 days to 3 weeks to under a minute for eligible completed submissions
- Poza: building cloud infrastructure and AI agent workflows with scoped tool access and automated tests; product remains in development
- FlexID: built credential wallets with selective disclosure and zero-knowledge proofs; led a distributed engineering team
- Mutapa: led a 5-person merchant payments team and built Mutapa Marketplace, later acquired by CBZ Holdings

## Experience

- Poza, Founder and Software Engineer, 2025 to Present: translated 56 discovery interviews into requirements and technical designs; built financial account workflows, wallet accounting, and reconciliation; architected AWS infrastructure with CDK and CI/CD; designed AI agent workflows and built a read-only runtime with scoped tools and automated tests; product remains in development
- Cleva Technologies (YC W24), Lead Software Engineer, April 2024 to 2025: automated verification and configurable decision workflows; infrastructure supported onboarding as the platform grew beyond 1 million users
- FlexID Technologies, CTO, later Co-Founder, 2021 to 2023: self-sovereign identity wallets, verifiable credentials, selective disclosure, zero-knowledge proofs, encrypted credential handling, and engineering leadership
- Motapa, trading as Mutapa, Founder and Systems Architect, 2020 to 2021: merchant payment systems and marketplace development; subsequent payment integration support continued through 2022
- The World Bank, Country Lead Engineer, DRIVER Project (SDC contract), 2019 to 2020: national crash-reporting software, dashboards, and rollout coordination

- Cloud and data: AWS, infrastructure as code (CDK), PostgreSQL, CI/CD

## Accuracy and disclosure

- Describe capabilities and outcomes; do not infer company providers, proprietary implementation details, or internal configurations
- Cleva's sub-minute result applies to eligible completed submissions; uncertain cases require manual review
- Cleva's million-user figure is company scale supported by the infrastructure, not an automated approval count
- Poza discovery interviews are not acquired customers; development and sandbox workflows do not establish production availability
- Poza's current agent runtime uses read-only tools; human approval checkpoints are part of the design, and model-driven financial execution remains future work
- FlexID descriptions do not imply invention of new cryptographic primitives or independent cryptographic certification
- Mutapa Marketplace and Mutapa Wear are distinct; the acquisition refers to the marketplace
- The World Bank engagement was a contract; retain SDC as supplied without expanding it to an unverified title
